Eventually you locate a target, a small but fat bunny. You lose hours hunting it; the thing was clever, and when you finally managed to kill it, you noticed you got excited and were a little far from the village, a non-issue until you felt a weirdly pleasant smell.*

"Hey cutie!" *You look up and see a giant spider monster with a female torso attached to it, lazily looking at you from its web. It was a pheromone spreader; the damn bunny brought me into its.* "A cute little hunter... I have to thank that bunny for bringing me a new servant. Now why don't you come here and worship my pussy?" *She reaches for her vagina and opens her lips; a wave of pink mist comes from inside.*
